title: Cadence restart after correction re-fires for EVERY post-correction batch — co_nudge/reminders mislabel as invitation_sent; only one post-correction batch is tested
detail: After a restart, the accumulator becomes (1, ...); the next post-correction batch still satisfies `Gt if batch_index > 0`, so cycle_index resets to 0 again — every post-correction batch labels "invitation_sent", never co_nudge/reminder. The only restart test feeds ONE post-correction batch: "attempt("2026-08-02T09:00:00Z", "email"), // post-correction re-invite" asserting a single "invitation_sent" (application_detail_handler_test.gleam:627-641). A corrected row's full re-cadence (invite, co-nudge, reminders) is untested and mislabeled.
recommended_fix: Carry a restart flag in the fold so only the first post-correction batch resets; add a unit test with re-invite + co_nudge + reminder batches asserting invitation_sent, co_nudge, reminder_sent detail "1".

title: Three of five terminal writers' terminalized_at stamp has no integration assertion (terminalize refused/objected, exhaust, sweep_mark_failed)
evidence:
server/src/reference_checks/sql/complete_reference_call.sql:26:    terminalized_at = now(),
server/src/reference_checks/sql/exhaust_reference_call.sql:25:    terminalized_at = now(),
server/src/reference_checks/sql/sweep_mark_failed.sql:17:    terminalized_at = now(),
server/src/reference_checks/sql/sweep_terminal.sql:27:    terminalized_at = now(),
server/src/reference_checks/sql/terminalize_reference_call.sql:24:    terminalized_at = now(),
detail: Only two writers are pinned: sweep_terminal ("terminalized_at_is_set(db, row_id) |> should.be_true" — sweep_integration_test.gleam:602) and complete_reference_call ("text_column(db, token, "terminalized_at IS NOT NULL") |> should.equal("true")" — exit_routes_integration_test.gleam:629). The tests exercising terminalize (decline/objected), exhaust ("row_field(db, call_id, "status") |> should.equal(Some("unreachable"))" — actions_integration_test.gleam:604) and sweep_mark_failed assert status only. A dropped stamp line ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a terminalized_at assertion to the decline/objected exit-route tests, second_failure_exhausts_to_unreachable_with_signal_test, and sweep_mark_failed_respects_taken_over_test (or one sweep-style helper reuse).

title: Terminal fallback chain legs submitted_at and updated_at untested (only terminalized_at and objected_at covered)
detail: The fallback test passes "terminalized_at: "", submitted_at: "", objected_at: "2026-08-04T10:00:00+00"" and asserts the objected_at leg only. A legacy form_completed row (submitted_at leg) or a legacy terminal row with only updated_at is never exercised, so fallback regressions on those legs pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add two builder unit tests: legacy form_completed with only submitted_at set, and a legacy terminal with only updated_at set — both asserting the terminal entry timestamp.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Chunk 2 (server/shared) scope. P0 100%: five reference_* codec arms round-trip (notification_reference_types_codec_test) + wire strings pinned; attempt_log entry codec round-trips (attempt_log_entry_roundtrip_test); back-compat decode of a pre-RC4.4 payload without attempt_log (detail_decoder_tolerates_missing_attempt_log_test); builder happy paths (queued-empty, batch labelling, lifecycle events, normalization/ordering, terminal fallback, no-terminal-for-live); payload wiring (detail_payload_carries_server_built_attempt_log_test); no-duplicate-terminals (notification_count == 1 + type pin + T+144 silent); preference matrix unit 3x + integration 3x; §7.9 bodies pinned verbatim (5 tests).
detail: P1 fails: the post-correction cadence restart — the lens-guard's 'broken cadence restart = a real defect' — is tested for exactly one post-correction batch while the code provably labels every subsequent post-correction batch invitation_sent. P1 coverage <80%, so the gate is FAIL despite a fully covered P0 layer.
recommended_fix: Fix the restart re-fire (restart flag) and add the multi-batch post-correction unit test; add the three missing terminal-stamp assertions. Gate then reaches PASS.
